instruction: A standing pronghorn antelope reduced to crisp angular facets, with a wedge-shaped muzzle, faceted forked horns and four slender triangular-prism legs. Flat-shaded panels alternate between tan, cocoa and chalk-white across the flank and rump patch, each facet catching light as a single unblended tone. The pose is alert, head lifted, tail a tiny three-triangle flick.
